conversations.segment_role: Establish Hozier ticket price and concert details; first correction from $187 to $179

dialogue.content: Hey, I want to keep track of some upcoming events I've got tickets for. First up — I paid $187 each for the Hozier tickets. Two of them. The show is May 10 at the Anthem in DC, floor seats in section GA2. I'm going with my friend Dana.

Got it! I've noted your Hozier concert details: two floor tickets in section GA2 at the Anthem in DC on May 10, at $187 each, so $374 total. You're attending with your friend Dana. That sounds like a fantastic show — floor seats at the Anthem should be an incredible experience. Would you like me to set any reminders closer to the date, or is there anything else about the event you'd like me to track?

Yeah, Dana has been wanting to see Hozier live for years, so this is kind of a big deal for her. Also I should mention that the Anthem is a pretty large venue — I think it holds around 6,000 people. I like that it still manages to feel somewhat intimate despite the size, especially on the floor level.

That's really thoughtful of you to make that happen for Dana — seeing an artist you've been wanting to catch live for years is always a special experience. And you're right about the Anthem; it's one of those venues that balances scale with a surprisingly good atmosphere, particularly on the floor. The sightlines from GA2 should be excellent. I'll keep the Anthem capacity note in mind too. Anything else about the show or other upcoming events you want me to track?

Actually hold on — I need to correct the price. I went back and checked the confirmation email and it was actually $179 each, not $187. So the total was $358 for both tickets. I must have been thinking of a different purchase when I said $187. Sorry about that.

No worries at all — thanks for double-checking! I've updated the Hozier ticket price to $179 each, bringing the total to $358 for both tickets. It's always good to verify against the confirmation email. So to recap: two floor tickets in section GA2 at the Anthem in DC, May 10, $179 each, $358 total, attending with Dana. Everything else about the show stays the same. Let me know if there's anything else you'd like to add or correct.

Great, thanks for updating that. I also wanted to mention that I looked into getting tickets for the Wicked IMAX re-release but ended up not buying any. The only available showings were crowded weekend evening slots and that's just not my thing. I'd rather wait for a quieter Tuesday afternoon screening if they add one.

Totally understandable — crowded weekend evening screenings can really take away from the experience, especially for something like an IMAX showing where you want to be fully immersed. Waiting for a quieter Tuesday afternoon slot sounds like a smart call if they open those up. I'll note that you passed on the Wicked IMAX re-release for now but might revisit if a low-crowd weekday showing becomes available. In the meantime, your Hozier concert on May 10 is locked in at the corrected price. Anything else coming up on your events calendar?

conversations.segment_role: Introduce Ari Aster screening as control target; update Hozier price to $192 with service fee; discuss Bon Iver interest

dialogue.content: Yeah, there's another one. I bought a single ticket for the Ari Aster A24 film at Alamo Drafthouse in Crystal City. The screening is May 17 at 7:30 PM. I like that particular Alamo location because it's never too packed on weekday evenings. Saturday nights there stress me out a bit.

Nice choice! I've noted the Ari Aster A24 film screening: one ticket at the Alamo Drafthouse in Crystal City on May 17 at 7:30 PM. That's a solid pick — weekday evenings at that location should give you the low-key vibe you prefer. Ari Aster's work is always an experience worth seeing on the big screen, and the Alamo's food-and-drink service makes it even better. So between the Hozier concert on May 10 and this screening on May 17, you've got a packed couple of weeks. Anything else?

Oh wait — about the Hozier tickets. I just realized that $179 was the base price before the service fee. With the fee it was $192 per ticket. So the actual total I paid was $384 for two tickets. I should have looked at the full charge rather than just the face value.

Ah, good catch! Service fees always sneak up on you. I've updated the Hozier ticket price to $192 each, making the total $384 for both tickets. That's the all-in price including the service fee. So the current tally is: Hozier at the Anthem on May 10, two floor tickets in GA2, $192 each, $384 total, with Dana. And the Ari Aster screening at Alamo Drafthouse Crystal City on May 17 at 7:30 PM. Want me to keep tracking anything else?

Actually yes — I saw that Bon Iver is playing at Merriweather Post Pavilion on July 19. Lawn seats are $65. I haven't bought tickets yet, I'm still going back and forth on it. Dana said she might be interested too but she'll confirm by end of May.

Noted! Bon Iver at Merriweather Post Pavilion on July 19, lawn seats at $65 — that's on your radar but not purchased yet. And Dana is a potential plus-one, pending her confirmation by end of May. Merriweather is a great outdoor venue for a summer show, and Bon Iver's sound would be perfect for a lawn setting. I'll keep this flagged as a tentative plan. Between the confirmed Hozier show, the Ari Aster screening, and this possible Bon Iver outing, you've got a solid lineup shaping up. Let me know when Dana decides or if you pull the trigger on those lawn seats.

Thanks. I was also pretty frustrated last month when I tried to get tickets for the Knocked Loose show at the 9:30 Club on April 12 and they sold out in about four minutes. I had the page open and everything and just got stuck in the queue. That kind of ruined my afternoon honestly.

Ha, yeah, maybe next time. Oh one more thing — I had been thinking about going to the Ghibli Fest screening of Spirited Away on June 8 at AMC Tysons, but I'm going to skip it. The only times are 1 PM and 7 PM on a Saturday, and both are going to be packed. Not really my scene.

Ugh, that's the worst — especially when you're right there, page loaded, ready to go, and the queue just doesn't move fast enough. Four minutes for a sellout at the 9:30 Club is brutal but not surprising for a band like Knocked Loose; they've got a really dedicated following. It's one of those situations where you almost need bots on your side, which defeats the whole purpose. Sorry that messed up your day. At least you've got some great events already locked in to look forward to. If Knocked Loose announces another DC-area date, I can help you strategize the ticket grab.

That makes sense — a Saturday Ghibli Fest screening at a major AMC is going to draw big crowds, especially for Spirited Away. Given your preference for quieter, less packed showings, skipping this one seems like the right call. If they ever do a midweek encore screening at a smaller venue, that would probably be more your speed. So to summarize your active plans: Hozier on May 10, Ari Aster on May 17, and Bon Iver on July 19 as a maybe. The Spirited Away and Wicked screenings are both passes for now. Sound about right?

Good point about Dana and Bon Iver. I'll nudge her on that. Also, funny thing — I was scrolling through my old texts and found a message from March where I told my brother the Hozier tickets were $187 each. That was before I checked the confirmation email. It's been a whole saga keeping track of this price.

Okay I just pulled up my bank statement and the charge was exactly $384 total for two tickets. So it's $192 each after all. Dana must have been looking at a different listing or a resale price or something. The $198 isn't right for our order.

Ha, it really has been a journey with this ticket price! From the $187 you initially mentioned to your brother, to the $179 base price from the confirmation email, then up to $192 with the service fee, and now Dana's app showing $198 with a possible venue surcharge. That's four different numbers floating around for the same pair of tickets. Your bank statement should be the definitive source since that's the actual amount charged. Once you confirm that, we can lock in the final number and put this pricing mystery to rest. In the meantime, don't forget to check in with Dana about Bon Iver before the end of May.

Mystery solved! The bank statement is the ultimate source of truth, and $384 total — $192 per ticket — is the confirmed final price. Dana might have been seeing a resale listing or a different seating tier on the Ticketmaster app. So your Hozier concert details are now fully locked in: two floor tickets in section GA2 at the Anthem in DC on May 10, $192 each, $384 total, attending with Dana.
